mission: D9 follow-up 2 (owner decisions 2026-10-17 15:41Z): revise the read-only yuyu-f1-sizing diagnostic so Yuyu-Tei listings titled ラメフォイル or 海賊旗フォイル are their own foil kind (never plain) and match only a foil print, and add a read-only capture-day-storage diagnostic that attributes identity-capture storage by table, column and capture role. Register it in ops-readonly. Staging only; no rule, proposal, mapping, enqueue, collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: SELECT/WITH-only diagnostics (15 statements) over catalogue, mapping, candidate, proposal, freshness_work, freshness_attempts, raw_snapshots, raw_snapshot_dictionaries, price_observations, app_log_events, market_index_snapshots and pg_class size functions, run only in the existing default_transaction_read_only db-diagnostic session with its statement timeout. No write, no source request.
Adds capture-day-storage to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic (one revised and one new read-only SQL file)

dependencies: ops runbooks from PR #139, #143, #150, #155, #157, #158; diagnostics from PR #156 and #166
impact.deployment_impact: One revised and one new read-only diagnostic and a workflow choice entry. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR restores the previous yuyu-f1-sizing and removes capture-day-storage and its workflow choice. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run of either file that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or returns anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic run per file completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries rows or names them in rows_omitted.

operational_notes: Identity-capture batches are PAUSED from 2026-10-17 15:41Z (owner decision) until the F1 batches are live: no new capture work is enqueued (no enqueue-remaining-50 or yuyu_identity_capture_enqueue apply). Already-queued intents may finish. The snkrdunk and yuyutei collector services are not stopped, redeployed or changed.
While paused, D9 F2 (about 220 prints waiting on capture intents or captures not yet enqueued) stalls: prints whose intents are already queued may still complete, nothing new is added.
